import json, os, sys
repo = sys.argv[1]
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(repo, "lib"))
import cli_help, cli_catalog, command_chains, model_watch

out = []
for i, c in enumerate(json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))):
    p = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(sys.argv[2]), f'c{i}.json')
    json.dump(c, open(p, 'w'))
    try:
        cli_catalog.load_catalog(p); out.append(True)
    except Exception:
        out.append(False)
print(json.dumps(out))
